name: Evonith BF Webapp
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; python -m pip install --user uv; uv sync --group dev; uv run python scripts/bootstrap_runtime.py --create; echo 'Packages installed and runtime bootstrapped'

postAttachCommand.frontend: EVONITH_RUNTIME_DIR=./runtime BACKEND_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080/api/v1 uv run streamlit run apps/frontend_streamlit/app.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
